scenes.title: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD)
scenes.narration: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulates how liquids and gases move and interact, transforming complex physical problems into solvable numerical ones. It's like a virtual wind tunnel, predicting behavior without costly physical tests.

scenes.title: Discretizing the Fluid Domain
scenes.narration: CFD begins by breaking down a continuous fluid domain into a tiny mesh of discrete cells, a process called discretization. Then, fundamental Navier-Stokes equations are applied to each cell to describe fluid motion.

scenes.title: Solving the Equations Iteratively
scenes.narration: A powerful solver iteratively calculates fluid properties for each cell, converging towards a stable solution. This involves millions of calculations, often requiring supercomputers to process the vast amount of data.

scenes.title: Aerodynamic Design Optimization
scenes.narration: In aerospace, CFD simulates airflow over aircraft wings, predicting lift and drag forces. This virtual testing optimizes wing shapes, reducing fuel consumption by up to 15% and enhancing safety before physical prototypes are built.

scenes.title: Impact Across Industries
scenes.narration: CFD's versatility extends from designing efficient car bodies and optimizing medical devices like heart valves, to modeling weather patterns. It provides critical insights, driving innovation and improving performance across countless fields.
